A Second Hyperparameter Derivative of a Response Quantity

Source: R/marginal_derivatives.R
ptheta_second.Rd

Differences a parent's analytic mixed derivative once more in each hyperparameter and carries the result through the penalty's map.

Usage

ptheta_second(pen, theta, inner, carry)

Arguments

pen

A penalty object.

theta

A named list of hyperparameters.

inner

A function of theta returning a named list, one entry per hyperparameter.

carry

A function placing one such entry into coefficient space.

Value

A named list keyed by hyperparameter pair.

Details

One central difference of an analytic quantity, which is the fallback distributions7 uses throughout; the two derivatives act on different hyperparameters wherever the pair is off the diagonal, and on the same one on it, where the reference is still analytic and only one difference is taken.
